app.title: Urban Air Quality Assistant
app.tagline: Actionable, low-emission daily routines and indoor smog hacks for severe winter pollution.

ventilate_at_cleanest_hour.label: Ventilate at cleanest forecast hour
ventilate_at_cleanest_hour.description: Air rooms when atmospheric dispersion peaks and ambient particulate dips.

keep_windows_closed_in_peak.label: Keep windows sealed during peak smog hours
keep_windows_closed_in_peak.description: Prevent outdoor smog infiltration by sealing the building envelope during stagnant periods.

use_hepa_purifier.label: Operate HEPA room air purifier
use_hepa_purifier.description: Continuously circulate and filter indoor air to drive down particle concentration.

shift_outdoor_activity_to_cleaner_hour.label: Shift outdoor activity to cleaner hours
shift_outdoor_activity_to_cleaner_hour.description: Reschedule outdoor commutes, errands, or recreation to the lowest-pollution window.

wear_fitted_respirator.label: Wear a well-fitted N95/FFP2 respirator outdoors
wear_fitted_respirator.description: Reduce inhaled particulate volume; a tight perimeter facial seal is essential.

switch_commute_mode.label: Switch to enclosed, filtered transit modes
switch_commute_mode.description: Shift from open two-wheelers or walking along major arterials to metro or closed buses.

improve_cooking_ventilation.label: Ventilate kitchen exhaust while isolating living areas
improve_cooking_ventilation.description: Run mechanical kitchen exhaust to clear combustion particles without venting into bedrooms.

avoid_waste_and_biomass_burning.label: Curtail localized waste and biomass burning
avoid_waste_and_biomass_burning.description: Eliminate neighborhood open burning to prevent hyperlocal toxic particulate spikes.

shared_clean_air_room_for_building.label: Create a shared clean-air room for the building
shared_clean_air_room_for_building.description: Designate and seal a communal room with shared HEPA filtration as a clean-air refuge.

reduce_vehicle_idling_at_school_gates.label: Curtail vehicle idling at school gates and drop-off zones
reduce_vehicle_idling_at_school_gates.description: Collaborate with schools to enforce anti-idling zones, reducing children's peak roadside exposure.

organise_carpool_or_shared_transport.label: Organise carpooling and shared neighborhood commutes
organise_carpool_or_shared_transport.description: Consolidate neighborhood travel trips to cut local tailpipe emissions during smog episodes.

plants_myth_check.label: Evidence check: indoor plants and air purification
plants_myth_check.description: Scientific consensus shows indoor potted plants have negligible effect on room-scale PM2.5.

assumptions.air_exchange_open: Assumes typical open window air exchange of 3.0 ACH (range 1.5 to 6.0).
assumptions.default_room_volume: Assumes standard default room volume of 45 m³ (range 30 to 70 m³) as no room dimensions were specified.
assumptions.air_exchange_closed: Assumes sealed envelope infiltration of 0.6 ACH (range 0.3 to 1.0).
assumptions.cleanest_vs_dirtiest_hour: Calculated by comparing forecast cleanest hour against peak diurnal hour.
assumptions.purifier_owned_cadr: Calculated using user-specified clean air delivery rate (CADR).
assumptions.purifier_recommended_cadr: Calculated based on standard 4.5 ACH room sizing rule of thumb.
assumptions.forecast_peak_vs_cleanest_outdoor: Direct difference between forecast peak and trough concentrations.
assumptions.respirator_fit_is_critical_caveat: Protective efficiency depends strictly on facial fit; leakage negates filter ratings.
assumptions.commute_enclosed_transit_mitigation: Directional reduction from cabin filtration in buses or underground metro systems.
assumptions.kitchen_exhaust_capture: Assumes mechanical exhaust captures cooking particulates before room dispersion.
assumptions.community_emission_curtailment: Directional benefit from preventing open municipal and agricultural fires.
assumptions.shared_clean_air_room_envelope: Directional estimate assuming clean air refuge room has sealed doors/windows and continuous filtration.
assumptions.school_gate_idling_exposure: Directional reduction in peak drop-off curb exposure when vehicle idling is eliminated.
assumptions.carpooling_trip_curtailment: Directional reduction in neighborhood vehicle emissions from trip consolidation.
assumptions.plants_phytoremediation_negligible: Chamber studies do not translate to real-world residential rooms.
assumptions.exposure_commute_assumes_ambient_outdoor: Commute microenvironment exposure conservatively equals ambient outdoor PM2.5.
assumptions.exposure_linear_hourly_microenvironment_: Linear hourly time-weighted average integration across schedule segments.

disclaimer.general_guidance: BreatheWise provides exposure reduction engineering estimates. It does not provide medical diagnosis, clinical treatment advice, or personalized healthcare prescriptions.

medical.seek_help_for_symptoms: If you or any household member experience acute respiratory distress, chest tightness, wheezing, or dizziness, seek immediate medical attention from qualified healthcare professionals.

summary.satisfactory: Air quality is satisfactory. Sensitive individuals should consider reducing heavy outdoor exertion.
summary.moderate: Moderate air quality. Keep windows closed during rush hours and ventilate during afternoon lulls.

ventilate_at_cleanest_hour.what_to_do: Open windows for cross-ventilation during the forecast clean window, then seal completely.
ventilate_at_cleanest_hour.why_it_matters: Flushes accumulated indoor CO2 and moisture without allowing outdoor winter smog spikes inside.

keep_windows_closed_in_peak.what_to_do: Keep all exterior windows and doors firmly sealed during morning and evening stagnation.
keep_windows_closed_in_peak.why_it_matters: Prevents cold winter inversion smog from infiltrating living spaces.

use_hepa_purifier.what_to_do: Run a true HEPA air purifier continuously in your main bedroom or living area.
use_hepa_purifier.why_it_matters: Mechanically captures fine airborne particulates (PM2.5) to keep indoor concentrations within safe limits.

shift_outdoor_activity_to_cleaner_hour.what_to_do: Reschedule outdoor runs, walks, and errands to the cleanest forecast window.
shift_outdoor_activity_to_cleaner_hour.why_it_matters: Significantly cuts cumulative inhaled toxic particulate dose without canceling physical routines.

wear_fitted_respirator.what_to_do: Wear a certified N95 or FFP2 respirator outdoors, pressing the metal nose clip for an airtight seal.
wear_fitted_respirator.why_it_matters: Filters out fine toxic aerosol particles. Note: an airtight perimeter seal is required; loose cloth masks offer minimal particulate protection.

switch_commute_mode.what_to_do: Choose underground metro or sealed, air-conditioned transit instead of open two-wheelers or walking along arterials.
switch_commute_mode.why_it_matters: Reduces direct roadside exhaust inhalation by staying inside filtered vehicle cabins.

improve_cooking_ventilation.what_to_do: Run kitchen exhaust fans and close interior doors to living areas during frying and high-heat cooking.
improve_cooking_ventilation.why_it_matters: Removes combustion ultrafines directly at the source before they disperse into resting areas.

avoid_waste_and_biomass_burning.what_to_do: Do not burn dry leaves, trash, or solid fuels; report open fires in your neighborhood.
avoid_waste_and_biomass_burning.why_it_matters: Hyperlocal biomass fires release concentrated plumes of carcinogenic soot and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons.

shared_clean_air_room_for_building.what_to_do: Collaborate with apartment neighbors to set up a shared clean-air community room with dedicated HEPA filtration.
shared_clean_air_room_for_building.why_it_matters: Provides a safe haven for vulnerable residents, children, and elderly neighbors who lack private purifiers.

reduce_vehicle_idling_at_school_gates.what_to_do: Turn off vehicle engines while waiting during school pick-up and drop-off hours.
reduce_vehicle_idling_at_school_gates.why_it_matters: Eliminates concentrated tailpipe emissions right at children's breathing height outside school gates.

organise_carpool_or_shared_transport.what_to_do: Organize carpooling or shared rides with neighbors for daily school and office runs.
organise_carpool_or_shared_transport.why_it_matters: Reduces the total number of combustion vehicle trips contributing to neighborhood winter smog.

plants_myth_check.what_to_do: Rely on mechanical HEPA filters and envelope sealing rather than potted houseplants for air purification.
plants_myth_check.why_it_matters: Scientific chamber studies demonstrate that potted houseplants have negligible impact on real-world room particulate levels.

about.title: How BreatheWise Works
about.subtitle: Physics-based exposure modeling, honest data sources, and strict privacy.
about.section1Body: BreatheWise continuously ingests physical ground station measurements from OpenAQ (CPCB, DPCC, and research monitors) and combines them with atmospheric chemical dispersion forecasts from the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) via Open-Meteo. When physical monitors and atmospheric models diverge by more than 2×, BreatheWise visibly flags the discrepancy so you can account for microclimate sensor variations.
about.section2Body: Unlike commercial apps that rely on arbitrary scores, BreatheWise computes indoor particulate concentrations using a standard single-compartment mass-balance equation. Indoor PM2.5 is determined by envelope penetration, air exchange rate (ACH), surface deposition, and mechanical clean air delivery rate (CADR). Every reduction figure displayed is the result of physical modeling—never marketing claims.
about.section3Body: Science requires honesty about what is known and what is assumed. The table below lists all assumptions, uncertainty bounds, and parameter sources used in our calculations.
about.section4Body: Your health conditions, children's ages, and household details belong to you. BreatheWise stores your inputs strictly in your browser's ephemeral tab session (sessionStorage). No profile data is ever saved to disk, cookies, localStorage, URLs, or external tracking services. You can purge all session state at any time with one click.
about.section5Body: BreatheWise is an environmental exposure engineering tool, not a medical device. It does not diagnose illness, prescribe medication, or provide clinical advice. If you experience severe cough, wheezing, chest discomfort, or shortness of breath, consult a physician or emergency medical provider immediately.
